quote: I want to become a Hunter just like my father.
There are liars who only lie when there's a reason to, and there are liars who also lie without reason.
I will become a Blacklist Hunter and bring down the Phantom Troupe.
Don't lump me in with you guys. I'm only in this for the money!
My greatest pleasure comes when such people buckle to their knees and beg for mercy.
